questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(180, 45, 90)

(128, 32, 64)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 3rd number) ÷ 6 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, (180, 45, 90)

⇒ (180 + 90) ÷ 6

= 270 ÷ 6 = 45.

For, (128, 32, 64)

⇒ (128 + 64) ÷ 6

= 192 ÷ 6 = 32.

Similarly, For **(224, 56, 112)**

**⇒ (224 + 112) ÷ 6 **

**= 336 ÷ 6 = 56.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 25 October 2004 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 2 November 2007?
questions.solution:
Given: **25 October 2004** was Monday.

Now,

2004 to 2007 = 3 Years (3 Ordinary Years).

And, 3 Ordinary Years have 3 odd days.

then, 25 October 2007 will be Monday + 3 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 25 October 2007 to 2 November 2007

= 6 days (October) + 2 days (November) = 8 days.

= 8 days → 8/7 = 1 week and 1 odd days.

So, **2 November 2007** will be Thursday + 1 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bb8c2398a403259bc6e0a8b5e7d4b5e5fab2438e1921856e4a4db885bd60bbb.png]

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Trim : Hair
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Actions performed on objects to maintain or improve them**.

Here,

Trim : Hair → **Trim** is an action performed on Hair to maintain or improve it.

Similarly,

Prune : Hedge → **Prune** is an action performed on Hedge to maintain or improve it.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All dresses are clouds.

Some clouds are tables.

Some tables are stones.

**Conclusion (I):** All stones are dresses.

**Conclusion (II): **Some dresses are tables.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8788e04f6ce30be489df1f232b6bfc416700321de3eb6066d6b0da547dba36bc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All stones are dresses → Does not follow (As all dresses are clouds, some clouds are tables and some tables are stones. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some dresses are tables → Does not follow (As all dresses are clouds and some clouds are tables. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows**"

questions.question: If 29 July 2001 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 20 February 2015?
questions.solution:
Given: **29 July 2001** was Sunday.

Now,

2001 to 2015 = 14 Years (11 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 11 Ordinary Years have 11 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 11 = 17.

18 odd days → 17/7 = 2 weeks and 3 odd days.

then, 29 July 2015 will be Sunday + 3 = Wednesday.

Now, the number of days between 20 February 2015 to 29 July 2015.

= 8 (Feb) + 31 (March) + 30 (Apr) + 31 (May) + 30 (June) + 29 (July) = 159 days.

= 159 days → 159/7 = 22 weeks and 5 odd day.

So, **20 February 2015** will be Wednesday - 5 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
